title: How to make the best Facebook ads in 58 seconds.  #justinlalonde
description: How to make the best Facebook ads in 58 seconds.  #justinlalonde
transcript: I've spent close to $10 million on Facebook ads just in the last six months to give me 58 seconds and I'll show you exactly how to start and scale your meta ad account. Understand that in this post endometa era it's all about creatives. The first thing I would do if I was you is define three target ICPs, so three different unique personas that you have. From there I would list out their top three to five desires and pain points that each of them have. And then from there what I would do is find competitors that are advertising for the same exact ICP, the snipe their longest running static ads to be able to then replicate them for my ICP and their pain points. Then I'm going to go to the ads manager create a single campaign and set my daily budget as a CBO campaign to beat my KPI target times the amount of ads that I want to launch. I'm going to create one ad set per ad creative I want to launch and set my targeting to be an automatic placement schedule those assets to go live at midnight. Then I'm going to let this sit and run for seven days. And in seven days check back the account kill everything that's not performing and if the overall campaign is profitable skill it by 20 percent that the last seven days show to be profitable.
